==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Noway4u is well known for his {{ci|Xerath}}, often being called the "German Aimbot" due to his spell hitting accuracy.
* Germany's biggest League of Legends streamer.
* Known for his calm, measured personality.
* Lives in Munich, Germany.
* Had three Top-30-Accounts in EUW-Challenger and one in the NA-Region by the end of May 2019.
* Plays League of Legends since Season 1.
* One of his many nicknames is the "Fertigsteller" which roughly translates to "The Finisher".
* His favourite dish is "Flammkuchen", a pizza-like tarte from the Alsace region with sour creme, bacon and onions.
* Travelled to Korea with several other German streamers and content creators in May 2022 and in the summer of 2023. 
** Has peaked challenger in Korean solo queue.
